name: comp-590
title: Team Nav Header
description: A compact dark header pairing a team pill with four icon-only nav links, a white plus Post button, a notification bell and a user avatar.
use: A content or social app needs a team switcher and a quick create button in a compact bar.
avoid: Nav items are icon-only with no visible labels, and the team names are hardcoded.
a11y: Icon links have screen-reader text, but naming for the bell and avatar depends on the separate menu components. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A dark header with a rounded team pill showing a letter avatar and team name, four icon-only nav links (home, compass, feather, search), a white plus Post button, a bell with an unread dot and a round user avatar.
behaves: Clicking the team pill drops a short menu of team names; choosing one swaps the avatar letter and label then closes the menu. The nav icons only react on hover.
customise: Team names and nav icons are written in the file; the notification and user menus come from separate components.
weight: light: A team pill, four icon links and three small buttons.
